title: I Posted the Copy-Card Photo After They Ran Prints on My Balance

parts.text: I posted the copy-card photo at 3:18 p.m. after they ran prints on my balance. The log showed a job I did not send. I was twenty-eight, analyst, standing at a copier that made me look like I owned the wait. I photographed the job name, the badge still, and the remaining pages. Facilities reversed the pages and dated the badge. I keep the job still. The copier finally knows my badge from theirs.

social.video_title: They ran prints on my copy-card balance — Part 1/1
social.description: Job I did not send, badge still, remaining pages. Facilities reversed it. Has a copier ever spent you?
